Great to visit Eaton Rapids Medical Center and see firsthand the incredible work their staff does for our community. Quality health care close to home is essential, and I’m committed to ensuring rural hospitals have the support they need to deliver. https://t.co/Cq8q7InIos

Since taking office two months ago, I’ve traveled to every county in my district multiple times in a sincere effort to meet with constituents from all walks of life. I’ve visited small businesses, schools, hospitals, non-profits, military units, veterans groups, and local governments. My team and I have also responded to more than 20,000 phone calls, letters, and emails while meeting with dozens of people from mid-Michigan every single week. Just 12 days ago, we hosted an interactive town hall with nearly 2,000 of my constituents, and I look forward to hosting another event again in April. While we have seen organized agitators try to disrupt and plunge public events across the country into chaos, I’m focused on getting results and will continue looking for meaningful ways to engage everyone in our community — even those who disagree with me.

Yesterday, I was honored to join @SecVetAffairs Collins for visits to the Battle Creek and Ann Arbor VA hospitals where we met with leadership and staff working hard every day to care for our veterans. Their commitment to supporting the VA mission is critical to making our medical centers the world-class facilities our veterans deserve.

This week, I visited Shiawassee Health and Wellness, Shiawassee county’s community mental health provider, with former State Rep. Ben Frederick. We had a thoughtful conversation about the challenges and opportunities in delivering quality mental health care close to home. Grateful for the dedicated team making a difference every day in the lives of Shiawassee County residents.

Great meeting with Big I Michigan, the largest trade association representing independent insurance agents in our state. I appreciated their insights on the challenges and opportunities within the industry, and I look forward to collaborating to support our local business community.

Great to meet with members of the Michigan Health & Hospital Association – including McLaren Healthcare, Henry Ford Health, and Trinity Health – to discuss how we can strengthen Michigan’s hospitals, support our frontline workers, and improve care for patients across the state. https://t.co/LsP466x8lR

It was great to tour Trinity Health Livingston Hospital in Brighton today. I saw  first-hand all the incredible work they’re putting in to deliver top notch medical care to our community. Excited to see how this new facility will serve the people of mid-Michigan! https://t.co/LM4hm1POvL

At the “War Cry for Change” press conference today, I joined @GruntStyleFdn, DAV, VFW, and General @RepJackBergman in demanding accountability and putting a stop to overprescription within the VA health system. Our veterans deserve better than a lifetime of pills, so I will continue fighting for alternative treatment pathways that provide our heros with the help they need without the risks of addiction.

Great news! → The House passed legislation this week to support our military and veteran community, including critical funding I fought and secure for:
✅ Supporting nonprofits that serve veterans
 ✅ Breakthrough PTSD psychedelic treatment
 ✅ IT accountability at the VA
 ✅ Protecting veterans’ 2nd Amendment right
We stand with those who served. 🇺🇸

While Dana Nessel and Michigan Democrats fight to keep illegal immigrants on Medicaid, Congress just delivered historic legislation that strengthens the program for those who need it most: mothers, children, and individuals with disabilities.

The One Big Beautiful Bill finally puts the needs of Michigan families first and eliminates this ridiculous waste, fraud, and abuse!

Broken and outdated computer systems have unreasonably delayed the delivery of benefits and health care for our veterans.

This week, I led an important oversight subcommittee hearing to review the VA's progress to modernize IT, use taxpayer dollars effectively, and deliver timely services to veterans.

Michiganders shouldn’t be forced to deal with poor air quality every summer because of Canada’s inability to manage its forests. Our neighbors to the north need to get these wildfires under control before the risk to our public health gets any worse.

It was great to be back at Camp Grayling yesterday for Exercise Northern Strike! 

I always loved participating in this combat training during my time in the Army, and it was special to see the operation from the other side. Thank you to @SecArmy, @RepJackBergman, and @SenatorSlotkin for teaming up to highlight how the next generation of soldiers are preparing to lead the way right here in Michigan.

.@McKesson's distribution center in Holt is a leader in efficiently delivering lifesaving medicines to pharmacies and hospitals across the region. Thanks to their hardworking team for showing me their state-of-the-art facility this week and discussing how we can continue to boost mid-Michigan job creation and improve health care.

I enjoyed hosting a health care town hall with various medical professionals from across mid-Michigan @Memorial_Owosso last week. I really appreciated their thoughtful questions and insight about how we can improve patient outcomes in our most rural communities. I look forward to continuing these conversations and supporting their important work as the historic $50 billion investment from the One Big Beautiful bill makes its way to our communities.

Physical therapists, skilled nurses, and other rehab professionals help people get back on their feet after an accident, sickness, or surgery. It was great to meet with the dedicated staff at WellBridge in Howell who help patients every step of the way on the road to recovery. https://t.co/FBJ6rxEoU3

I had a great time at the VFW National Home yesterday where I hosted a productive conversation with leaders of veterans organizations that serve mid-Michigan. We discussed needs for better transition support for veterans and fair treatment for the qualified service of reservists and National Guard members. This input is invaluable as I continue working in Congress to get our American heroes the benefits they’ve earned.

From hospitals and schools to offices and factories, the Boldt Company constructs critical buildings across the country. Thank you to the team for welcoming me to the facility in Lyon Township to discuss the construction industry and the unique needs of employee-owned companies like Boldt. The historic tax relief we delivered this summer will help the Michigan workers who are building our country and paving the way for our booming economy.

AI is going to be a critical tool to help deliver health care to veterans in the 21st century. We must take the necessary steps to ensure we use it wisely and that we’re protecting our veterans' data and information. Thank you to @michiganstateu’s Dr. Mohammad Ghassemi for joining my @HouseVetAffairs Technology Modernization Subcommittee hearing today to discuss how AI can improve health care for veterans.

Our veterans sacrificed for this country, and they deserve the certainty of knowing their benefits and services will not be cut off or interrupted. This week, I introduced the VA Extenders Act to maintain critical services: housing assistance, suicide prevention, health care initiatives, and more.

Yesterday in Lansing, I enjoyed a great meeting with Dr. Adenike Shoyinka and her team at the Ingham County Health Department. We discussed their work in our community and ways we can continue partnering to expand health care access for mid-Michigan families. https://t.co/dDPEhp0dJR

Critical veteran services, including suicide prevention grants, a program to support rural mental health, and assistance for homeless veterans, expired when the government shut down. Democrats need to stop playing politics and restore support for our veterans. https://t.co/AXoeE8MgKW
